summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a reverse stock split approved by stockholders at the June 23, 2026 annual meeting. The board authorized a 1-for-4 ratio, effective August 17, 2026 at 12:01 a.m. ET, reducing outstanding shares from 2,422,906 to approximately 605,726, with authorized shares unchanged at 601 million. The stock will trade on Nasdaq under ticker PFSA with a new CUSIP. This corporate action adjusts share price and per-share metrics, potentially to regain compliance with listing standards. No premium or value is involved. Watch for continued listing viability and post-split trading volatility.
